Job Title: Head Of Software Development
Company: Vireak Buntham Express Co Ltd
Location: Phnom Penh
Employment Type: Full Time

Job Summary
Lead software innovation for a fast-growing travel and transport business, turning ideas into reliable digital products and improving how teams, partners, and customers connect. You will guide development strategy, delivery, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
• Define the software roadmap and align development priorities with business goals.
• Lead and mentor developers, fostering strong engineering standards and teamwork.
• Oversee project delivery, ensuring quality, timelines, and budget control.
• Collaborate with operations and stakeholders to turn needs into practical solutions.
• Review system performance and drive improvements in reliability, security, and scalability.
• Manage vendors, tools, and technical resources to support efficient delivery.
• Promote innovation through testing, prototyping, and process optimization.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
• Proven experience in software development leadership or technical management.
• Strong understanding of SDLC, system architecture, and project delivery practices.
• Ability to lead teams, solve complex problems, and make sound decisions.
• Experience working with cross-functional business teams and stakeholders.
• Excellent communication, planning, and organizational skills.
• Familiarity with modern development tools, databases, APIs, and cloud platforms.
• Experience in travel, transport, or service-based industries is a strong advantage.
